rfam.description: GlmZ RNA activator of glmS mRNA
rfam.comment: This RNA was discovered in E. coli during a large scale screen [1]. The sraJ gene was expressed in early logarithmic phase, but its level decreased with cell growth [1]. Specific cleavage products of this RNA were found [1]. Identified in Yersinia pseudotuberculosis as Ysr248/153/sR016 [4]. The structure of GlmZ_SraJ was reported in PDB: 8B0I and 8B0J [5].

curation.author: Bateman A, Gardner P, Ontiveros-Palacios N
